_sagegui.name: Semi-tryptic — biofluids
_sagegui.description: Semi-enzymatic search for serum, plasma and other biofluids, where endogenous protease activity leaves peptides cleaved on only one side. Tolerances match the tight template. semi_enzymatic roughly doubles the peptide space, so database prefiltering is switched on to bound peak memory. STARTING POINT ONLY -- these are not yet validated against a real biofluid run; adjust missed_cleavages and the length range to your own data.
